notes:
v0.1.20 — low-latency terminal (virtio-serial) + startup fix:
- New terminal transport: a direct virtio-serial channel between the app and the guest (PTY shell per tab) instead of SSH-over-SLIRP — noticeably lower keystroke latency. Falls back to SSH automatically if unavailable. Validated on real hardware under WHPX.
- Fixed a startup hang: QEMU exited immediately when the 'logs' folder was missing (portable ZIPs ship without it) — the controller now creates it before launch.
- Includes the earlier MTTCG + fast-SSH latency wins.
